missing: roads outside the municipality of Salvador (Lauro de Freitas, Simões Filho, Camaçari, Itaparica...) except BR-324 from DNIT SNV: the OSM extract covers Salvador plus about 500 m
OSM roads are a snapshot of 2019-01-18; anything opened later is absent
ramps (*_link) and classes below secondary are not included
inland water (lagoons, reservoirs) is only present where IBGE has a separate water tract
notes: land[].rings and municipality[].rings: first ring is the outer boundary, any further rings are holes; every ring is closed (first point == last point)
land is clipped to data_extent, so straight edges on that rectangle are not coastline
municipality is the LAND of the municipality of Salvador (mainland and islands), not the legal limit, which also covers part of the bay
roads[].name is '' for unnamed connector segments; do not label those
roads[].alias comes from the OSM alt_name tag
roads[].drawn_km is the total length of the drawn lines; dual carriageways count twice
water_labels are label anchors chosen by hand inside the water; they are not surveyed positions
